<size=44>April 20, N.F. 113, 
FAC DisSea Surveillance Zone, 
Alarm Level: A.</size>
Near coordinates (4.2k, 0.5k), there is anomalous ring activity in a 200-meter diameter area with a sharp increase in M-value.
Video Loading... Video Loading...
Abnormal contamination outflow at 33 degrees of the <color=#fb9259>BR-000</color> border confirmed! A large number of Mania-infected creatures are spilling into the surrounding area!

The FAC promptly strengthened its defenses. Soldier 172 from Unit N25 of FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings spotted the Singularity, and an on-site preliminary evaluation of its M-value is being conducted.

The target is believed to be a Sinner, classified as <color=#fb9259>S-Class</color>. The target exhibits no intention or sanity to communicate. No record is available regarding its previous activities. Its identity has yet to be determined.

<size=31>Initial power assessment: <color=#fb9259>Gravity Manipulation</color>. It can manipulate any object below a certain mass to attack in a wide range with destructive power. Its power seems have been greatly magnified by the DisSea strange phenomena; the light is noticeably distorted.</size>

The FAC's death toll:

<color=#fb9259>26</color> deaths as of April 20.
<color=#fb9259>36</color> deaths as of April 23. The Singularity has broken through the First Broken Frontline. <size=44>Requesting Backup!</size>
<color=#fb9259>58</color> deaths as of April 24. The Singularity has broken through the Second Broken Frontline. <size=44>Requesting Backup!</size>
The reply received on April 27, N.F. 113 from Paradeisos Ring Research Institute reads:

The activity level of the BR-000 rises and falls in cycles. This new round of increases is nothing out of the ordinary, and it won't last longer than one month. The whole city is currently troubled by a new wave of Mania incidents. It'll take time to reassign some of the troops. Before help arrives, FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings shall continue with the operation on its own.
<size=40>Repeat: <color=#fb9259>Continue with the operation independently, keep up the defense.</color> Keep up the efforts!</size>

114 deaths as of April 28. The Singularity is about to reach the Third Broken Frontline.
136 deaths as of April 29. The Singularity has reached and is attacking the Third Broken Frontline. Units N21, N23, N24, N25, N26, N28, N29, and N30 of FAC Special Operations Forces Against Black Rings have gone radio silent.

Nightingale, acting chief of the MBCC, has arrived at the Third Broken Frontline along with the intelligence department, the medical team, and the DisSea temporary arrest team, to help fight off what is supposedly a Sinner.

As things stand, the MBCC can only provide a minimum amount of support.
Repeat: The MBCC can only provide a <color=#fb9259>minimum amount of support</color> for the time being, as the MBCC Chief, ${PlayerName}, is <color=#fb9259>unable to get involved</color>.
Who is it...?
Where am I...?

Somewhere not far away, the tide ebbs and flows. A red moon rises above the sea, eerie and menacing. What does it look like? A giant egg, an all-seeing eye, a black hole, a bottomless abyss, or all of the above?

A great many shadows ooze out of the moon. These are living things bent on luring innocent souls into the dark. They snake their way to where your broken consciousness lies, toying with it before latching onto it.
You're finally... back...
We've... found you...
No, this isn't the place... I've come to the wrong place.
Stay away from me!
Special Effects (Earring)

A drop of icy water breaks the surface of a still pool, and a voice sounds in the deep recesses of your consciousness. As the moving mist disperses, your eyesight returns. You are greeted by a scene the likes of which you've never seen before.
